deco_clear._source: Perdix 3 Rev B p.60: 'By default, the safety stop counter is enabled in recreational modes and the deco clear counter is enabled in technical modes'; Perdix 2 Rec p.28: once the stops are complete the safety stop counts down. The Tec pages turn the counter on with a layout rule override ({"rules": {"deco_clear": {"count_up": true}}}); checked against the simulator's Perdix 2 (A7)

notice_style._source: Teric Rev H5 p.26 / p.25 figures: a filled banner with the caption (WARNING / INFO) small above the message in black, and a CLEAR tab on the right; yellow for warnings, green for Deco Clear, cyan for the other info events

Shearwater._ndl: p.17 (yellow below the Low NDL alert, default 5 min, p.24); ndl_zero: p.33
Shearwater._po2: p.19: flashing red outside the PPO2 limits; p.62 Adv. Config 2 defaults OC Min 0.18, OC MOD 1.40, OC Deco 1.61. 1.61 is used so a deco gas is not flagged; the bottom gas should use 1.40 once the gas list is known (A2)
Shearwater._safety_stop: p.27 (11 m trigger, countdown below 6 m, window 2.4-8.3 m, yellow when paused, reset below 11 m, Complete); adapt p.17; same on Peregrine TX Rev C p.26, Petrel 3 Rec Rev C p.26, Teric Rev H5 p.25, Tern Rev B-1 p.24, Perdix 3 Rev B p.58-59. Duration: 3 min fixed by default (Deco Setup p.55 offers 3 min, Adapt and CntUp; the default is taken as 3 min, as the simulator does); Adapt's 5 min rule stays available with adapt.enabled

tank_reserve._source: p.57: reserve default 50 bar (range 28-137), Reserve Pressure warning below it, Critical Pressure warning below the larger of 21 bar or half the reserve; p.40 figure: value on a yellow box (reserve) or red box (critical); same text on Perdix 3 Rev B p.154, Peregrine TX Rev C p.56, Petrel 3 Rec Rev C p.56, Teric Rev H5 p.74. The box fill is drawn as text colour until the renderer gains a value highlight (A2)

Shearwater._tank_pressure_fill: assumed; p.40 only says the bar graph scales to the rated pressure. With the reserve box the bar follows the box colour (A5)
Shearwater._tissue_load: assumed (copied from the Garmin table); the N2 bar graph's colour steps are not given as percentages
Shearwater._deco_stop: p.28: approach within 5.1 m (yellow title, flashing up arrow), at the stop down to 1.5 m deeper (green, check mark), flashing red when shallower; ceiling_phase: Teric Rev H5 p.26 / Tern Rev B-1 p.25 distinguish shallower than the stop (yellow) from shallower than the ceiling (flashing red); a Perdix 2 (p.28) colours both red
Shearwater._deco_clear: p.28: Deco Clear counter counts up from zero once all stops are complete
Shearwater._ascent_rate: p.12: 1 arrow per 3 m/min, white under 9, yellow 9-18, flashing red over 18 (6 arrows); deco calculations assume 10 m/min

notice_style._source: Perdix 2 p.22: each primary notification is a message in yellow across the bottom row under Warning (Alert for the p.24 custom alerts, Error for resets) with Confirm on the right, until a button is pressed. A log does not record the press: shown for show_seconds (assumed). Same on Peregrine TX p.21, Petrel 3 Rec p.24

gf_colors._source: Perdix 2 p.20: GF99 yellow when the GF High-modified M-value is exceeded, red above 100 %; SurGF coloured by the current GF the same way. GF high from the log when it carries one (UDDF decomodel), else the Med default 85 (p.~55)

gas_time._source: Perdix 2 p.44-45 and p.57: GTR = (Ptank - Preserve - Pascent) / (SAC x Pamb), SAC over the last two minutes at 1 ATA, direct ascent at 10 m/min, reserve 50 bar default; 'wait' until two minutes of data; no GTR once deco stops are required (p.26). Pascent as SAC x ascent minutes x mean ambient is our reading of 'the pressure used for the ascent'

persistent_notices._source: p.23 'High CNS': CNS limit reached; the figure's wording follows the Perdix 2 p.13 box layout
p.23 'MOD, go up'; p.13 figure: red box MOD / depth / up arrow
p.23 'Near MOD': within 1.9 m below the MOD, a notification only

persistent_notices._order: p.23 lists High CNS, MOD go up, MOD switch gas, Near MOD, Better Gas; 'switch gas' and 'Better Gas' need the gas list (not modelled)

display._source: Perdix 2 p.12: 'When in meters, one decimal place is shown' (the feet figure shows 45 ft)

Garmin._manual: Descent Mk3 series owner's manual (Mk3) and Descent X50i owner's manual (X50i); pages are PDF pages. Full list: hud_rules_sources.md

safety_stop._source: Mk3 p.10 / X50i p.9-10: after a dive of at least 11 m, stop at 5 m; the timer starts within 1 m of the ceiling, pauses more than 3 m above it, resets below 11 m; Safety Stop Started when ascending above 6 m (Mk3 p.14); depth and stop depth turn yellow more than 2 m above the ceiling (warn_above_m, not drawn yet, A2). min_depth 1.2 (surface) assumed

badge_states._source: X50i p.10 figure (stop box); mk3i: real screenshots test_data/dive_computers/garmin_mk3i
badge_states._warn: Mk3 p.13 / X50i p.12: more than 2 m above the safety stop ceiling the current depth and stop depth turn yellow (phase 'warn')

Garmin._ndl: assumed. The manuals only give Approaching NDL alerts at 10 and 5 min (Mk3 p.13, X50i p.12); real screenshots show the NDL white at 99+
Garmin._tank_pressure: replaced by tank_reserve (the old 60 / 70 bar bands had no source)

tank_reserve._source: Mk3 p.14 / X50i p.13 transceiver alerts: the tank pressure value turns yellow below the reserve pressure and flashes red below the critical pressure; both are settings (Reserve Pressure, Mk3 p.6 / X50i p.5). Defaults are not in the manuals: 50 / 25 bar assumed

Garmin._tank_pressure_fill: assumed; the gauge is scaled by the working pressure (Mk3 p.6), colours not given
Garmin._po2: Mk3 p.4 / X50i p.4: PO2 Warning and PO2 Critical are settings; the value flashes yellow above Warning and red above Critical (Mk3 p.13-14). Defaults not in the manual: 1.4 / 1.6 assumed (they match a real mk3i FIT dive_settings record)

deco_stop._source: Mk3 p.10, p.13 / X50i p.10, p.12: Approaching Deco Stop within one stop interval (3 m); stay within 0.6 m of the ceiling; more than 0.6 m above it the depth and ceiling flash red and the stop timer pauses

lockout._source: Mk3 p.13 / X50i p.12: more than three minutes above the deco ceiling puts the decompression lockout into effect (not modelled yet, A2)

Garmin._tissue_load: Mk3 p.7-8 / X50i p.7: green 0-79 %, yellow 80-99, red 100 % or more
Garmin._ascent_rate: Mk3 p.7-8 / X50i p.7: green under 7.9 m/min, yellow 7.9-10.1, red over 10.1; alert Ascending too fast over 9.1 m/min for 5 s (Mk3 p.13)

notice_style._source: Mk3 p.12-14 / X50i p.12-13 give the alert texts; how long a message stays and its colour are not described: white, show_seconds assumed
